extracted.intended_audience: Navy commands and claimants, OPNAV-443 staff, contracting officers, Quality Assurance Evaluators (QAEs), and CA program managers
extracted.subtask_description: Recommendations, evaluation criteria, and data-collection metrics for post-award management of Navy Commercial Activities (CA) contracts, including QA, PWS definition, mobilization readiness, cost accounting, staffing, procurement method, and training.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality Assurance Manual publication
rubrics_metrics.description: Claimants publish a Quality Assurance Manual similar to the one published by NAVFAC to assist commands that have transitioned to contractor operations in establishing and conducting their Quality Assurance programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Manual should contain policy guidelines on sampling techniques, sample checklists, measurement issues, etc.; be a 'how to' type of publication easily used by QAEs.

rubrics_metrics.name: QAE training course establishment
rubrics_metrics.description: Claimants establish QAE training courses or obtain quotas from other claimancies offering such courses for each of their commands that will transition to a contractor.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide command-level training capacity or quotas so QAEs are trained prior to transition to contractor operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: OPNAV-443 post-award instruction
rubrics_metrics.description: OPNAV-443 issue an instruction dealing with the post-award issues of converting to a contract operation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Instruction should outline options for dealing with contractor performance problems, basic guidance on forming contingency plans and operations, and consider streamlining government personnel recruiting and detailing procedures to assemble temporary operations; provide streamlined procedures for bringing onboard temporary contractors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Central contingency fund
rubrics_metrics.description: Establish a central contingency fund at OPNAV-443 to financially assist commands that must assemble a contingency operation due to poor contractor performance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fund allows activity to rid itself of deficient contractors until resolicitation; provides OPNAV-443 visibility of costs associated with poor contractor performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audit/research on PWS adequacy for complex/multi-function operations
rubrics_metrics.description: Conduct audits/research on complex operations and multi-function contracts to determine the overall adequacy of the PWSs in these situations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Based on findings, re-evaluate or possibly eliminate some complex operations from the CA inventory or determine what was done to ensure the PWS was written well; consider funding additional resources during cost comparison specifically for PWS preparation; develop CA functional experts at claimant level to assist in PWS preparation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sequenced CA review scheduling (simple-to-complex)
rubrics_metrics.description: Task base commanders with scheduling CA reviews so simplest CA functions are reviewed first and sequence moves from simpler to more complex functions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This allows development of expertise on PWS preparation at activity level before tackling complex operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication/distribution of proven PWSs
rubrics_metrics.description: OPNAV-443 publish an annual list of commands that have undergone CA reviews sorted by functional area and distribute to major claimants; major claimants disseminate list to commands scheduled for review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allows commands to contact other commands that have undergone review in the same functional area to gain access to 'proven' PWSs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Improve PWS Preparation training availability/publicity
rubrics_metrics.description: Improve availability and/or publicity of the PWS Preparation training courses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make training more available and known to commands and staff involved in PWS drafting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mobilization contingency plan requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Require a mobilization contingency plan as part of the original contract and require periodic updating of the plan as part of normal report requirements included in the contract.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plans should be updated periodically and be contractual deliverables to mitigate mobilization risks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Periodic mobilization drills with contractors
rubrics_metrics.description: Commands conduct periodic 'mobilization drills' with the contractor similar to those conducted by the Reserves to test adequacy of mobilization plans.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Drills verify contractor readiness and plan effectiveness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include mobilization considerations in contract form selection
rubrics_metrics.description: Include mobilization considerations when determining contract form and evaluating need for support function coordination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Multi-function contracts may be easier to coordinate and administer during periods of mobilization; consider contract form accordingly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Establish special AG/SAG and Cost Account Codes for contractor operations
rubrics_metrics.description: NAVCOMPT establish a special Activity Group/Sub-Activity Group (AG/SAG) code for Base Contractor Operations and separate Cost Account Codes (CAC) for contract administration, contract operations and contract administration clerical support.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enables separate identification, accumulation of actual cost data, establishment of historical cost database to prepare better cost estimates, improve cost control and program monitoring.

rubrics_metrics.name: Study standard vs actual cost factors and inconsistencies
rubrics_metrics.description: Conduct additional studies on the Navy's cost accounting system and assess the current policy of using standard cost factors for indirect costs in the cost comparison process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Give particular emphasis to rationale/basis for standard cost factors and research inconsistency between cost factor used for accelerating government employees' fringe/retirement benefits in budget formulation and the factor used in CA Cost Comparison process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Establish actual cost database for contract administration and revise handbook
rubrics_metrics.description: Establish an actual cost database for contract administration based upon revisions to the Cost Accounting system and revise the Cost Comparison Handbook to reflect higher contract administration staffs where necessary.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Address understaffing by using actual cost data to set realistic staffing allowances in the handbook.

rubrics_metrics.name: Design scalable baseline contracts to preserve budget flexibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Design/tailor contracts to consider budget reductions by establishing a baseline contract and price that can be scaled down to reduced versions with 60-90 days notice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include stipulations for excluding or reducing certain services as part of baseline, require price quotes on reduced services as part of original bid proposal to reduce negotiation costs if reductions invoked.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procurement method requirement for complex/multi-function operations
rubrics_metrics.description: Require that all complex and multi-function operations use negotiated (or the two-step) procurement method and incorporate into OPNAVINST 4860.7B.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensures appropriate procurement process for complex/poorly defined operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evaluate cost-plus award fee vs FFP for complex contracts
rubrics_metrics.description: Conduct a systematic evaluation of the desirability of using a Cost Plus Award Fee Contract for complex and multi-function contracts versus Firm Fixed Price (FFP) contracts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: General contracting guidance notes FFP not well-suited for complex or poorly defined systems or operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preference consideration for multi-function contracts
rubrics_metrics.description: Claimants give serious consideration to requiring multi-function contracts instead of single function contracts at activities with a large inventory of CA operations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Multi-function contracting may improve coordination and administration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specialized contracting officer training for CA contracts
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide specialized training for Contracting Officers who will be administering CA contracts, focusing on most appropriate contracting techniques, methods and procedures to use in specific situations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include in-depth presentation of options for dealing with contractor performance problems specifically as it relates to CA functions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statistical training for QAEs (tandem sampling etc.)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide statistical training for QAEs, particularly tandem sampling techniques and other sampling techniques appropriate to monitoring service (versus product) operations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure QAEs can properly apply sampling methods suited to service-monitoring contexts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Training on performance measurement and quality surveillance
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide training on performance measurement and conducting quality surveillance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Improve ability to measure contractor performance and carry out effective surveillance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publicity and wider offering of CA courses/tools
rubrics_metrics.description: Increase publicity and offerings of CA courses/tools already in existence, including automated Cost Comparison software developed at CNET and Cost Comparison and PWS Preparation courses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make existing tools and courses more accessible to commands and staff.

rubrics_metrics.name: Need for independent and systematic post-award reviews and data collection
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognize lack of independent/systematic post-award review and difficulty obtaining routine program management data because it is not systematically collected.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recommend more systematic collection of program management data and more frequent independent reviews and audits to inform program debates and decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: MEO Savings calculation method
rubrics_metrics.description: MEO (Most Efficient Organization) savings are computed based on the number of positions eliminated by implementation of the MEO and calculated for 3 years (typical length of cost comparison).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Savings ($) are calculated for each position eliminated using the 'cost per position' from the NAVCOMPT Budget Exhibit OP-08 for the applicable fiscal years.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conversion savings calculation method
rubrics_metrics.description: Two types of savings realized when a function goes to contract: (1) MEO Savings and (2) Conversion Savings — the difference between in-house and contract bids.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Conversion savings are calculated for the period covered by the cost comparison (usually 3 years).

rubrics_metrics.name: Program expense accounting
rubrics_metrics.description: Program expense should be calculated as the salary costs of dedicated CA administrative positions (shown per position for given fiscal year).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include administrative staffing costs when evaluating net program savings and payback.

rubrics_metrics.name: Collect before-and-after performance statistics
rubrics_metrics.description: Commands should collect specified statistics for both before and after contract award to assess contractor performance impact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Questionnaire lists that respondents should provide before/after values for numerous metrics (see storage/warehousing and food service metric lists).

rubrics_metrics.name: Criteria used to judge contractor performance (questionnaire list)
rubrics_metrics.description: List of criteria used to evaluate whether a winning contractor performed satisfactorily since award: Observation; Routine Command Performance indicators; Timeliness measures; Accuracy measures; Safety measures; Customer satisfaction measures; External inspection results; Internal audit results; Quality Assurance inspection results; Other (specify).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allow multiple criteria to be checked; enables qualitative and quantitative assessment of contractor performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Storage and warehousing performance metrics (detailed list)
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific metrics for T801 Storage and Warehousing: receipt-to-stow on-time (%); issues on-time (%); warehouse refusals (%); shipped on-time (%); receipt accuracy (%); issue accuracy (%); ability to meet emergency requirements; general warehouse appearance (cleanliness); local deliveries on-time; number of safety violations (documented); number of incoming Reports of Discrepancy (RODs); % items properly packed for shipment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Collect these metrics before and after award to assess contractor performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Food service operations performance metrics (detailed list)
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific metrics for S713 Food Service Operations: Sanitation inspection results; equipment maintenance; financial returns (over or under issue); cycle menu development; customer satisfaction indicators; attendance levels; number of safety violations (documented).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use sanitation and customer satisfaction along with operational metrics to evaluate food service contractors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of deductions and other remedies for substandard performance
rubrics_metrics.description: Commands should record whether they have taken deductions for substandard performance, including how many deductions, average monthly amount, cumulative amount, and which performance areas were deficient.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also record other actions taken (e.g., Contract Deficiency Reports), any litigation/claims (dollar amounts and results), and documentation burden associated with claims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Record litigation/claim metrics and documentation burden
rubrics_metrics.description: If litigation proceedings or claims filed against the contract, record dollar amount involved, results, type and amount of documentation required, and approximate number of documents generated in response.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Helps quantify dispute costs and administrative burden post-award.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document contract administration staffing and time allocation
rubrics_metrics.description: Commands should report how many personnel are involved in contract administration, their titles, grade level, and whether full-time or part-time (with percent of time if part-time).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to quantify administrative costs and staffing adequacy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identify additional unanticipated administrative costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Identify any additional administrative costs associated with administering the contract that were not anticipated (e.g., purchase of clocking devices, dealing with disputes, excessive documentation requirements).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Quantify such costs where possible to inform cost comparisons and program expense accounting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Track contractor-caused damages and compare to in-house baseline
rubrics_metrics.description: Record whether contractor caused damage beyond normal wear and tear, the dollar amount, and whether similar damages occurred when function was government-operated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comparison clarifies whether contracting introduced new damage liabilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Record contractor prior history and reasons for contractor failure
rubrics_metrics.description: Document whether this is first contractor to assume responsibility; if not, record what happened to previous contractors (e.g., did not exercise option, contract default, lost resolicitation bid).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides context for contractor performance risk and reliability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Monitor contract price changes during performance
rubrics_metrics.description: Track if original bid dollar amount changed during the contract, by what amount and for what reasons (e.g., mandatory pay raises, change in scope or mission).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Helps assess cost stability and adequacy of original pricing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pre-award survey documentation
rubrics_metrics.description: Record whether a pre-award survey was conducted before award, who performed it, and what was actually done.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pre-award survey quality influences contractor selection and later performance; document thoroughly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Track PWS modifications and their effects
rubrics_metrics.description: Record whether PWS experienced many modifications during contract, what areas changed (scope of work, procedural changes, deduction schedule, performance requirements summary, other) and whether any changes affected contract price.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Modifications indicate PWS definition adequacy and influence contract cost/administration burden.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assess contractor experience and evaluation method
rubrics_metrics.description: Determine if winning contractor was experienced in the operation and document assessment methods: references, previous work with Navy, on-site visits of other operations, or other methods.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Experience assessment criteria should be documented to justify award decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assess accuracy/completeness of cost comparison process
rubrics_metrics.description: Ask whether cost comparison process accurately reflects cost of contracting out and, if not, why (options include: performance/quality considerations not accounted for; administrative cost estimate is too low; litigation costs not accounted; transition costs >10% differential; costs for administering RIF procedures not accounted for; impact on productivity of remaining government workers not accounted; other).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify which unaccounted factors may bias cost comparison results and require adjustment or further study.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research topics for further study (evaluation criteria)
rubrics_metrics.description: List of areas recommended for further research that serve as high-level evaluation dimensions: performance effectiveness and cost savings attributable to functions retained in-house after CA review; in-depth evaluation of Navy Cost Accounting System and CA Post-Award Control system; use of Standard Cost vs Actual Cost basis in Cost Comparison; ROI assessment of CA program vs other efficiency measures; comparison of FFP vs Cost Plus Award Fee contracts; evaluation of which CA functional areas are more successful under contractors; research on budget flexibility and private sector practices; examination of CA operations' mobilization capability; reconciliation of fringe/retirement cost factor methodology.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These research topics define additional metrics and studies needed to refine CA program evaluation and policy.
